runner.rationale: The runners the component's own CI already uses, so a threshold is reproducible by anyone who can run CI and a number measured on a developer's machine is explicitly not evidence. The cost is variance between runs on identical input, which the wall-time allowance below carries and the absolute caps do not.

measurement.method: In-process stopwatch around the scenario body, peak managed memory from GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes, and work units counted by the codec's own budget counters. No external profiler, so nothing here needs a tool-manifest row.
